576: "The ill" - And this law also applies, that when varicella (chickenpox) blossoms in babies and they die, one should decree a fast, and a penitential prayer for ill children has already been published, and the Shlah (Rabbi Isaiah ben Avraham Horowitz, 1555-1630) wrote that one should take one's children out from the city during a time like this when a disease is contagious.
